result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to truly understand one another across their differences.

Not just agreeing, not just tolerating, but actually listening with curiosity—seeing the fears, hopes, and reasons behind someone else’s beliefs without immediately reducing them to “wrong” or “evil.” That one shift would ripple everywhere: less polarization, less cruelty, less dehumanization, less war. It wouldn’t fix everything, but it would make many other problems more solvable.
